title: Yummy-Yellow Peruvian Pear Pandan Leaf Wrap
description: A creamy and tangy dish featuring pear slices wrapped in a pandan leaf with a dollop of stone-bowl sauce for a brunch-friendly meal.

ingredients.name: Pear
ingredients.notes: Choose firm pears to avoid too much moisture.

ingredients.name: Stone-bowl sauce
ingredients.notes: Use store-bought or homemade as a guide for quantities.

ingredients.name: Pandan leaves
ingredients.notes: Look for fresh pandan leaves. Avoid dried ones unless specified.

instructions: Wash and peel pears; slice them thinly.
Prepare the stone-bowl sauce by mixing ingredients according to package instructions.
Place pandan leaves in a bowl for easier handling.
Fold each pear slice into pandan leaf wraps, top with dollops of stone-bowl sauce.
